pathfinding.Name: Pathfinding around walls
pathfinding.Hint: A dragged token walks cell by cell around walls. No way through — no move: the unreachable part is drawn dashed and the token stays. A large token never stops with a wall inside it. Square grids; hex and gridless scenes move as in core.

altBypass.Name: Alt goes through walls
altBypass.Hint: Whose Alt, held while dragging, switches off walls, pathfinding and walking around enemies.

avoidEnemies.Name: Walk around enemies in combat
avoidEnemies.Hint: In a started combat, players' tokens walk around visible hostile tokens at the same height. Through an enemy — Alt. Square grid only.

hidePreviewVision.Name: The drag ghost keeps the fog
hidePreviewVision.Hint: While a token is dragged, its ghost copy neither sees nor clears the fog of war before the real move.

hideDragHighlight.Name: No coloured path cells
hideDragHighlight.Hint: The cells of the drag path are not painted in the player's colour.

facing.Name: Face the way of movement
facing.Hint: The token is mirrored toward where it walks, left or right. The token art should look right. The size does not change.

faceTarget.Name: Face the target
faceTarget.Hint: A player's token (the selected one, else their character's) turns toward their last target.

updateNotice.Name: Update notice
updateNotice.Hint: When a newer ADMaps Pathfinder release is out, the GM gets a window on load: the installed and the new version and how to update. «Don't show again» hides it until the next release.

Notify.Clipped: The token cannot stand here: a wall would be inside it.

Update.Title: ADMaps Pathfinder: update available
Update.Body: A new version of ADMaps Pathfinder is available: {latest} (current: {current}).
Update.How: To update, return to Setup, open Add-on Modules and update ADMaps Pathfinder.
